items.question: What visualization and mental focus must accompany the prescribed muttering of the mantra?
premises: The practitioner meditates on a figure placed and impaled on a spike.
The practitioner should mutter the mantra.
The practitioner must have an undivided mind.
items.inference: Mantra recitation is to be performed while visualizing the spike-impaled figure with single-pointed attention.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the visualized figure is carried over from the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: Meditating on her as placed and impaled on a spike, one with an undivided mind should mutter the mantra.
